description: Department of Forest Conservation - State Lands Karungalikulam 02 Madagala and Ulpathgama Kanda as Reserved Forest
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of state land as a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. It includes detailed geographic coordinates and boundaries of the land area (1188.32 hectares), making it clearly about land classification and conservation rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
